title: 共振星仪 / Resonant Armillary
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party Studio-authored graph and original demo music; existing attributed renderer adapters; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 金色与青色圆环交错组成音乐雕塑：低频改变环的倾角，整体能量与高频点亮金属表面；包含可编辑构图组件和原创演示音乐。
descriptions.en-US: Interlocking gold and cyan rings form a musical sculpture: bass tilts the rings while overall energy and treble light their metallic surfaces, with an editable composition component and original demo music.
